ad_intro:
PharmEasy (pharmeasy.in) is a Health e-commerce brand running ~70 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.1-2 Cr/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. One of India's largest e-pharmacies (Threpsi Solutions), consolidating after its shelved IPO.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: discount-heavy, trust ugc gap - The gap: trust / patient-outcome UGC. (2) Landing page: a deal-heavy homepage with no trust signals (lab/consult tie-ins) above the fold and no refill/subscription callout. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Discount-heavy, trust UGC gap. The gap: trust / patient-outcome UGC.
Copy leak: Current angle is discount/offer-led. Missing angle: trust and chronic-care value over pure discounts.
Landing page leak: A deal-heavy homepage with no trust signals (lab/consult tie-ins) above the fold and no refill/subscription callout.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
competitors: Doctor consult + appointment funnels with strong retargeting.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy trust / patient-outcome UGC
Shoot 15 fifteen-second trust / patient-outcome UGC and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add trust badges, a consult+meds bundle, and a subscription/refill flow on the landing page. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
